title: Biobased dihydrolevoglucosenone (Cyrene) enables rapid and efficient synthesis of acylals under microwave irradiation
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00325C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tobias Keydel, Andreas Link
Acylals can be synthesised quickly under microwave irradiation using Cyrene as a sustainable solvent. The products can be purified by precipitation from water or by a solvent-sparing chromatography, as described in this study.
